Additionally, high inflation can also affect the value of collateral, which can impact the lender's ability to recover their losses in case of default. Inflation can also affect the borrower's ability to repay their loans, as their income may not keep up with the rising cost of living.

In summary, a high inflation rate can have a negative impact on loan repayment by making it more difficult for borrowers to service their loans, increasing interest rates and loan terms, and affecting the value of collateral.
